name: Angel of Destiny
oracle_text:
Flying, double strike
Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you and that player each gain that much life.
At the beginning of your end step, if you have at least 15 life more than your starting life total, each player this creature attacked this turn loses the game.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, if you have at least 15 life more than your starting life total, each player this creature attacked this turn loses the game.

needs.what: a value reading a player's starting life total (rule 103.4; 40 in Commander), so a condition can compare life_of(you) >= starting_life(you) + 15
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has life_of, max_life_of and min_life_of but nothing for the starting life total; hard-coding const 55 would silently assume the format's starting life and break for any non-40 start

needs.what: a player set (for for_each_player / lose_game's player) of every player the source creature attacked this turn, recorded per attacking object in the turn ledger
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector key attacked_this_turn filters objects that attacked, and the value attacked_this_turn counts per player whether they attacked; nothing records which defending players a given creature attacked, and for_each_player's players spec has no such option
